name: JAK-12 Automatic Shotgun
description_html:
Overview

This mod introduces the JAK-12, an automatic shotgun created by Infinity Ward and inspired by the AA-12 from Call of Duty.

- Features basic configuration with an 8-round magazine.

- Models and textures are sourced from Call of Duty by Infinity Ward.

Setup and Usage

1. Unzip the downloaded files.

2. Drop the mod folder in to the spt directory.

3. Launch the game.

4. Visit Mechanic’s shop or the Flea Market to find the rifle and its parts.

Note for MPT/Fika users:

If you encounter bundle loading issues (e.g., white texture or doge), manually distribute bundle files:

- Copy /user/mods/\[this mod name\]/\[this mod name\]/bundles folder

- Merge it with the same-name folder under /user/cache/

This method applies to all my mods.

Permissions and Legal

- When reuploading or sharing this mod, please clearly indicate the author or source.

- Do not distribute files with the .bundle extension (or its variants) from this mod without permission.

- Respect the original creator’s rights

- Models, Textures, Sounds, Animations: Infinity Ward (Call of Duty)

- Converted Textures: John_Titor

- Animation Baking: Miraki (来自二次元的公主殿下)

- Tarkov Port & Code: Massivesoft

Known Issues

- Some animations may look a little weird.

Credits
